features: **A new login page.** Your own artwork fills the left of the screen; the sign-in form sits on the right with the legal notice under the heading, a yellow Sign in button, and "Sign in with Microsoft" below it. On a phone the artwork becomes a banner across the top.

**Upload your own login artwork** under Branding settings → Login portal → Login artwork. It is shown whole and centred on every screen shape, and the space around it is filled with the picture's own edge colours so it blends in. Leave it empty to keep the built-in slideshow.
**"Forgot password?" now says who to ask** — your administrator, who can send a reset link — and "Need access?" points to the support address set under Branding.
actions: `./update.sh v2.17.1` applies everything, including one small database change. No downtime beyond the usual restart. Upload the login artwork afterwards under Branding settings.
fixes: The password field has a show/hide button.
